request: Extend the approved cinematic homepage treatment across the other CorkBot pages.
design: Large editorial headlines and dark product scenes on the four guides; existing homepage image assets reused.
Full-width chapter backgrounds, a sticky workflow introduction on tall desktop screens, six clear workflow steps and generous closing calls to action.
Two-column concept gallery with larger unaltered renders, gentle hover zoom and the existing accessible viewer.
Product imagery beside the launch signup panel, readable releases, restrained apparel placeholders, and quiet policy/confirmation layouts.
Shared large footer wordmark, outline buttons, and consistent responsive typography.
motion: Optional one-time section entrances through the existing IntersectionObserver.
Native CSS view-timeline image depth, only where supported; no scroll interception or new dependencies.
Reduced-motion CSS disables animation and transitions. Sticky workflow disabled on phones, short screens, and with reduced motion.
Forms, downloads and policy paragraphs are not reveal targets; content stays visible without JavaScript.
copy: Guide headlines: Ask. Review. Make.; Make your mark.; Your artwork. At work.; Explore the motion.
Gallery headline: More ways to move. Concept status remains explicit.
Removed old prototype/studio-photo captions from guide and launch imagery in line with operator direction.
Launch FAQ now says photographs show the design to expect, with small refinements continuing; package details and future-module status remain clear.
preservation: Signup form byte-identical to previous commit.
Privacy, reservation notice and thank-you main content byte-identical.
No changes to API handlers, analytics, gallery/menu logic, download targets, release manifests, redirects or headers.
Homepage layout and separate MarketApp product pages unchanged.
